name: indicator_cell_to_source_record_lineage
description: Build deterministic cell-level lineage from manifested source records to H6 indicator cells.

identity.reason: publication source_record_id locates a table column but may omit the geographic row

resolution.raw_locator_collision_policy: append explicit H6 cell coordinates to the record-node identity

invariants: every H6 observation has one complete core lineage path
every node_id and edge_id is deterministic and unique
every source record node is unique within its artifact and explicit cell coordinates
raw source locator collisions are reported rather than hidden
every indicator cell is reachable from every manifested observation assigned to it
no lineage edge is inferred by label similarity
